full_description:
Hi,

I need four logo packages prepared for DTG printing, front-chest branding, and twill appliqué combined with embroidery.

Please follow the supplied artwork exactly. Do not interpret, redesign, alter, redraw or recreate any part of the designs.

LOGO 1 – MAIN LOGO FOR DTG PRINTING

Please prepare Logo 1 for professional DTG printing.

Requirements:

* Make the artwork high-resolution and print-ready
* Vectorise the emblem, borders, mesh and all text
* Preserve the dog as detailed high-resolution raster artwork
* Improve the resolution and clarity of the dog’s fur, eyes, nose, mouth, teeth, saliva and claws
* Preserve the exact dog, face, expression, colouring and proportions
* Preserve the exact emblem, wording, fonts, distressed textures, layout and proportions
* Remove only the external background and provide genuine transparency
* Retain all intentional black areas within the design
* Prepare at 300 DPI for the intended final print size

Please supply:

* Editable AI, EPS, PDF and SVG files
* High-resolution transparent PNG
* Clearly labelled and separated colour layers
* Print-ready DTG artwork

Do not fully vectorise or redraw the dog if this would alter its appearance. The dog must remain exactly as supplied.

LOGO 2 – NINE COLOUR OPTIONS

Logo 2 is the same exact design as Logo 1, supplied in nine different colour options.

Please apply the same professional DTG preparation process to all nine versions.

Requirements:

* Keep the exact same dog, face, claws, emblem, wording, fonts, layout and proportions
* Preserve the exact colour placement shown in each supplied reference
* Do not create new colour combinations
* Do not alter the dog’s natural black-and-tan colouring
* Vectorise the emblem, borders, mesh and all text
* Preserve the high-resolution dog and its detailed fur
* Prepare each version with genuine transparency
* Prepare each version at 300 DPI and the intended final print size

Please supply every colour version separately as:

* Editable AI, EPS, PDF and SVG files
* High-resolution transparent PNG
* Clearly labelled and separated colour layers
* Print-ready DTG artwork

LOGO 3 – FRONT-POCKET LOGO

Please prepare the supplied “BF SECURITY” front-pocket logo.

Requirements:

* Vectorise the complete logo
* Preserve the exact BF lettering, scratch, SECURITY wording, fonts, textures, outlines, spacing and proportions
* Do not reposition, redraw, simplify or redesign anything
* Prepare it for a front left-chest application
* Provide a genuine transparent background

Please supply:

* Editable AI, EPS, PDF and SVG files
* High-resolution transparent PNG
* Clearly labelled colour layers
* Print-ready artwork

Any jacket mock-up supplied is for size and placement reference only. It is not the master artwork.

LOGO 4 – LARGE BACK TWILL APPLIQUÉ AND EMBROIDERY

This large back logo will be applied to a 100% nylon bomber jacket using a combination of twill appliqué and embroidery.

Please prepare the artwork specifically for professional embroidery digitising.

Keep the design, wording, fonts, layout and proportions unchanged. Do not interpret, redesign, alter or recreate it.

Production specifications:

* Finished back width: approximately 30–32 cm
* Use black twill appliqué for the filled sections of “SECURITY”
* Use silver/grey embroidery for the borders around “SECURITY”
* Embroider “BITE FORCE,” “K9-UNIT” and the paw in dark charcoal/black thread
* Preserve the original distressed and scratched appearance
* Simplify only the extremely fine distressed lines that physically cannot be embroidered
* Any necessary simplification must be controlled and must retain the same overall scratched appearance
* Do not remove the distressed style
* Do not make any other visible changes without my written approval

Please supply:

* Editable vector master file in AI, EPS, PDF and SVG formats
* Separate, clearly labelled colour and production layers
* Separate appliqué and embroidery layers
* High-resolution transparent PNG preview
* Clean embroidery-ready artwork for the professional digitiser
* A visual production proof showing the finished 30–32 cm layout

The graphic designer is responsible for preparing clean, properly separated artwork. The embroidery company should create the final machine file, such as DST, based on its own embroidery machines, hoop setup and thread requirements.

Do not simply auto-convert the supplied image into an embroidery file. The fine scratched details require careful, controlled simplification by an experienced embroidery digitiser.

The final embroidery must be tested using a physical sew-out on a sample of the actual 100% nylon bomber-jacket material before production begins.

IMPORTANT – NO DESIGN CHANGES

For all four logo packages:

* Do not interpret or redesign anything
* Do not alter or recreate the dog
* Do not change the dog’s face, expression, head size, fur, colouring, mouth, teeth, saliva or claws
* Do not change any wording, spelling, fonts or letter shapes
* Do not change the emblem, spikes, mesh, borders, paw or scratch marks
* Do not change the layout, spacing, alignment or proportions
* Do not add or remove any element
* Do not make changes based on personal preference
* Do not use automatic tracing or conversion if it changes the original appearance

This job is strictly for professional artwork preparation, resolution improvement, vectorisation, DTG setup, twill-appliqué separation and embroidery preparation.

If any visible alteration is technically unavoidable, please stop and obtain my written approval before making the change.

Please provide digital proofs of all artwork for approval before finalising the files or beginning production.

Kind regards,

Tim Strickland
Bite Force Security Pty

• Native CAD project file 
• Gerber and NC drill set ready for fabrication 
• Pick-and-place CSV

full_description:
Business Contract Drafting 
Exercise – 1 
a) Parties to the Agreement - The two parties to the agreement are the 
employer (the company) and the employee (the individual). They should be 
defined at the beginning of the agreement as follows: 
1. Party 1 (The Company/Employer): As TechFlow Solutions Private 
Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, 
having its Corporate Identification Number (CIN) [………………..], with its 
registered office at [Full Address], Bangalore, India (hereinafter referred 
to as “the Company” or “the Employer”). 
2. Party 2 (The Employee): Ms. Priya Sharma, daughter of [Her Father's 
Name], residing at [Her Full Residential Address] (hereinafter referred to 
as “the Employee” or “the Business Development Manager”). 
b) Title of the Agreement 
The title of an agreement should appear at the very top of the first page, 
typically centred and in bold capital letters. 
Given that the employment is for a specific duration of two years, the most 
appropriate and accurate title would be:- 
FIXED-TERM EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT 
This title is ideal because it immediately clarifies that the contract is not for 
permanent employment but for a pre-defined, limited period (of 2 years), 
which aligns with the company's intention. A simpler, but less specific, 
alternative would be "Employment Agreement." 
Here are the appropriate clauses for each scenario with their significance: 
a) Giving Specific Meaning to Words; 
 Clause: Definitions Clause 
 Significance: This clause is crucial for avoiding ambiguity. It provides 
precise meanings for key terms used throughout the agreement, 
ensuring all parties share a common understanding. 
b) Payment Details 
 Clause: Consideration / Remuneration Clause 
 Significance: This clause formally outlines the payment Ms. Sharma will 
receive. It specifies the amount, frequency, and timing, which is a core 
element of the contractual exchange, as Rs.75,000/- per month. 
c) Ms. Sharma's Assurances 
 Clause: Representations and Warranties Clause 
 Significance: In this clause, Ms. Sharma provides formal assurances 
about her qualifications and the truthfulness of her statements. A 
breach of these warranties can give the company grounds for specific 
legal remedies, including termination or damages. 
d) Background Information 
 Clause: Recitals / Background Clause 
 Significance: This clause sets the stage for the agreement by providing 
context and outlining the parties' intent for entering into the contract. It 
can be useful for interpreting the main operative clauses if a dispute 
arises. 
e) Company's Training Responsibility 
 Clause: Obligations of the Company Clause 
 Significance: This clause clearly defines the company's specific duties 
towards Ms. Sharma. It establishes a binding commitment for the 
company to provide the necessary training (For a Period of One Month), 
ensuring she is equipped for her role.

full_description:
Business Automation Specialist Needed — End-to-End Automation for Distribution Business

I run a B2B distribution business for laptops/electronics, and I am looking for an experienced Business Automation / AI Automation Specialist who can help me automate as much of the business as realistically possible.

I am not looking for someone to automate just one task. I want someone who can understand the entire business workflow and design an integrated automation system covering sales, lead generation, marketing, customer management, administration, reporting, follow-ups, collections, and internal operations.

What I Want to Build

The goal is to create a system where routine work is automated and I can manage the business from a central dashboard.

1. Lead Generation & Lead Management

* Find and collect potential retailers/dealers/distributors from different sources
* Maintain a centralized lead database
* Automatically categorize leads by location, business type, potential, etc.
* Lead scoring and prioritization
* Automatically assign leads to salespeople
* Track every interaction with each lead
* Follow-up reminders and automated follow-ups
* Identify leads that have gone cold
* Convert leads into customers automatically through defined workflows

2. Sales Automation

* Track enquiries and quotations
* Generate quotations automatically
* Product/catalogue management
* Check product availability/inventory
* Track orders from enquiry → quotation → order → billing → payment
* Automated WhatsApp/email notifications
* Follow-up automation for pending orders
* Salesperson performance tracking
* Daily/weekly/monthly sales reports
* Customer-wise and product-wise sales analysis
* Identify high-potential customers

3. Customer/Dealer CRM

I want a proper CRM system for every dealer/customer containing:

* Contact details
* Location
* Business type
* Credit limit
* Outstanding amount
* Payment history
* Purchase history
* Products purchased
* Last interaction
* Next follow-up
* Sales potential
* Customer rating/category
* Risk level

The system should give me a 360° view of every customer.

4. Marketing Automation

* WhatsApp marketing workflows
* Email marketing
* Product launch campaigns
* New stock announcements
* Price updates
* Promotional campaigns
* Customer segmentation
* Automated follow-ups
* Re-engagement campaigns for inactive dealers
* Birthday/occasion messages where appropriate
* Track campaign performance

5. Admin Automation

I have many repetitive administrative tasks that I want to reduce significantly.

Examples:

* Data entry
* Form filling
* Creating reports
* Updating spreadsheets
* Generating documents
* Invoice/order-related workflows
* Maintaining customer records
* Internal task assignment
* Meeting scheduling
* Reminders
* Daily/weekly management reports
* Document organization
* Approval workflows

Where possible, the system should automatically extract information from emails, WhatsApp messages, invoices, PDFs, Excel files, etc.

6. Payment & Credit Management

This is particularly important for a distribution business.

I want automation for:

* Outstanding payment tracking
* Payment due-date reminders
* Automated customer reminders
* Overdue payment alerts
* Customer credit-limit monitoring
* Alerts when a customer exceeds predefined limits
* Customer credit-risk categorization
* Collection follow-up lists
* Daily outstanding report
* Ageing analysis
* Escalation when payments become overdue

7. Inventory & Product Automation

Where technically possible:

* Inventory tracking
* Stock alerts
* Low-stock notifications
* Product-wise sales velocity
* Slow-moving inventory identification
* Product availability updates to sales team
* Automatic sharing of updated product lists/prices
* Sales forecasting

8. Management Dashboard

I want a simple dashboard where I can see the entire business at a glance.

For example:

Sales

* Today’s sales
* MTD sales
* Sales target vs achievement
* Salesperson performance
* Product-wise sales

Customers

* New customers
* Active customers
* Inactive customers
* Top customers
* Potential customers

Receivables

* Total outstanding
* Overdue amount
* Customer-wise outstanding
* Ageing

Operations

* Pending orders
* Pending quotations
* Pending follow-ups
* Pending collections
* Important tasks

The dashboard should ideally be accessible from both computer and mobile.

AI Automation

I am also interested in using AI wherever it genuinely makes sense.

For example:

* AI-based lead qualification
* AI-generated customer follow-ups
* AI-assisted sales messages
* Automatic summarization of customer conversations
* Extracting information from documents
* AI sales insights
* Predicting which customers are likely to purchase
* Identifying customers who need follow-up
* AI assistant that can answer questions about my business data

For example, I should eventually be able to ask:

“Which customers haven’t purchased in the last 60 days but previously purchased regularly?”

or

“Show me all customers with more than ₹2 lakh outstanding and payments overdue by more than 15 days.”

or

“Which leads should my sales team call today?”

and get an immediate answer.

Important Requirement

I do not want someone to simply connect a few Zapier/Make workflows and call the project complete.

I want someone who can first understand my business, map the workflows, identify repetitive processes, and then build the automation architecture.

You should be comfortable recommending the right combination of tools such as:

* CRM
* ERP/accounting software
* Google Sheets/Excel
* WhatsApp Business/API
* Email
* Make/Zapier/n8n
* AI/LLM APIs
* Dashboards
* Databases
* OCR/document automation
* Custom software where required

I am open to changing tools if you can demonstrate that there is a better solution.

What I Expect From You

The ideal freelancer should:

* Have strong experience in business process automation
* Have built automation systems for SMEs/distributors/wholesalers/retail businesses
* Understand CRM, sales and lead-management workflows
* Have experience with APIs and integrations
* Understand AI automation
* Be comfortable with WhatsApp/email automation
* Be able to work with Excel/Google Sheets/databases
* Be able to build dashboards
* Think about scalability, reliability and data security
* Be able to explain technical concepts in simple business terms

Project Approach

I would prefer this to be done in phases:

Phase 1 — Business Audit

* Understand my current business processes
* Identify repetitive tasks
* Identify bottlenecks
* Identify automation opportunities

Phase 2 — Automation Blueprint

* Design the complete system
* Recommend tools/software
* Define workflows
* Define database/CRM structure
* Provide implementation roadmap

Phase 3 — Implementation

* Build the core CRM/automation system
* Integrate required platforms
* Build dashboards
* Build AI workflows
* Test everything

Phase 4 — Optimization

* Monitor the system
* Fix issues
* Improve workflows
* Add additional automations

Deliverables

I expect:

1. Complete business-process map
2. Automation roadmap
3. CRM/lead management system
4. Sales automation
5. Marketing automation
6. Admin automation
7. Payment/collection automation
8. Reporting/dashboard system
9. AI automation where appropriate
10. Documentation of the entire system
11. Training/handover
12. Ongoing support if required

When Applying

Please do not send a generic proposal.

In your proposal, please answer:

1. What similar business automation systems have you built?
2. Have you worked with distribution/wholesale businesses?
3. What technology stack would you recommend for my business and why?
4. What processes would you automate first?
5. Give me an approximate timeline for Phase 1 and the full implementation.
6. Give me an estimated budget/range.
7. Provide 2–3 examples of relevant projects you have completed.
8. What would you need from me to start?
9. How would you make sure the system can scale as the business grows?

Important: I am looking for a long-term automation partner, not just a freelancer who completes a few individual tasks.

If you are genuinely experienced in AI + business automation + CRM + sales operations + admin please apply.

I am willing to start with a paid business-process audit/strategy phase before proceeding with the full implementation.
